events.title: Arrive & check in
events.detail: No timed bookings tonight: arrival time is unconfirmed. Eat near Farringdon if kitchens are still open.
events.travel: Heathrow → Farringdon: allow 60–90 min after reaching the station, plus immigration and bags. From Stansted allow 90–120 min via Liverpool Street.

days.title: Westminster & the South Bank
days.subtitle: Wednesday · the classic sights, then the West End

events.title: Brunch in Farringdon
events.detail: Eat before setting off; carry a compact umbrella.

events.title: Buckingham Palace & St James’s Park
events.detail: Exterior palace stop, then walk through the park. This is not an interior tour or a Changing of the Guard appointment.
events.travel: 12:45–13:20 · Tube to St James’s Park, then walk; allow 35 min.

events.title: Westminster Abbey, Big Ben & Parliament
events.detail: See the Abbey exterior, Parliament Square and Elizabeth Tower, then cross Westminster Bridge. Abbey interior is an optional swap, not included in this timing.
events.travel: 13:50–14:20 · walk through St James’s Park; allow 30 min.

events.title: London Eye ride
events.detail: Aim for a 15:30 ticket. This block includes the queue, security and a 30-minute rotation. Ticket time is queue entry, not boarding; allow more if busy. Nothing is booked.
events.travel: 15:05–15:25 · cross Westminster Bridge and walk to the Eye; 5 min buffer.

events.title: South Bank riverside walk
events.detail: Walk towards the National Theatre and Waterloo Bridge. In rain, shorten the walk and stop for coffee instead.

events.title: Covent Garden
events.detail: Browse the covered market, Seven Dials and nearby shops. Individual shop hours vary.
events.travel: 17:30–18:00 · walk across Waterloo Bridge, about 25–30 min.

events.title: Dinner in Chinatown / Soho
events.detail: Choose a restaurant on the night; allow a queue or reserve a table. Budget roughly £25–40 each, depending on drinks.

events.title: Soho drinks · optional late finish
events.detail: Stay for another drink or head back early. Last orders vary; after midnight do not assume the Tube is still running.
events.travel: Return: allow 30–40 min on foot to Farringdon, or check a live bus/taxi route.

days.title: Thursday
days.subtitle: Daytime reserved · meet again in the evening

events.title: Existing daytime plans
events.detail: Daytime kept clear. Studio-tour entry time and return journey are not confirmed; no extra sightseeing has been squeezed in.

events.title: Dinner in Clerkenwell
events.detail: Meet near the accommodation after everyone is back. Keep this flexible if the studio return runs late.
events.travel: 19:00–20:00 · regroup, travel and freshen-up buffer.

events.title: Local pub · optional
events.detail: A relaxed evening close to home before the Oxford day.
events.travel: Allow 10–20 min to walk back, depending on the chosen pub.

days.title: Oxford
days.subtitle: Friday · colleges, old streets and a pub dinner

events.title: Farringdon → Oxford
events.detail: Elizabeth line to Paddington, then a direct GWR service to Oxford. Buy a train that fits this window; these are planning allowances, not a verified train timetable. Have brunch before departure or take food.
events.travel: Allow 25 min to Paddington, 20 min interchange, around 55–65 min on the train and contingency.

events.title: Covered Market lunch
events.detail: Walk into the centre and get a quick lunch or coffee. Keep it light if you ate on the train.
events.travel: 13:45–14:05 · station → Covered Market, about 20 min walk.

events.title: Christ Church college & cathedral
events.detail: Target a 15:00 entry. The Great Hall normally reopens after the weekday 12:00–14:00 lunch closure; the site requires exit by 17:00 in term. Check closures and availability before paying. If sold out, swap for the meadow and exterior walk.
events.travel: 14:40–15:00 · walk and arrival buffer.

events.title: Radcliffe Square & the old university
events.detail: Exterior walk: Radcliffe Camera, Bodleian courtyards where accessible, Bridge of Sighs and Broad Street. No library interior tour is assumed. Expect dusk/darkness; reverse with Christ Church if daylight matters more.

events.title: Oxford pub dinner
events.detail: Try the Turf Tavern area or another central pub; reserve if possible. A fallback restaurant is preferable to waiting for a table and missing the train.

events.title: Return to Farringdon
events.detail: Walk to Oxford station and take a suitable direct service to Paddington, then Elizabeth line. Aim for a train around 19:30–20:00; choose the actual return when booking.
events.travel: Allow 25 min walk plus station buffer, 55–65 min train and 30–40 min for Paddington → Farringdon.

days.title: Shopping & the skyline
days.subtitle: Saturday · West End shops, Tower Bridge, then the Shard

events.title: Brunch near Oxford Circus
events.detail: Start in the West End, with a proper meal before shopping.
events.travel: Leave Farringdon at 12:00; allow 20–25 min via Elizabeth line to Tottenham Court Road and walk. Brunch may run to 13:00.

events.title: Oxford Street, Regent Street & Carnaby
events.detail: Three hours for shopping. Follow Oxford Circus → Regent Street → Carnaby Street; split up and agree a meeting point if useful. Skip extra sightseeing rather than compressing this block.

events.title: Tower Bridge & the Tower of London
events.detail: Exterior views only: walk the riverside and across the bridge. Tower interiors and the bridge exhibition are not included.
events.travel: 16:10–17:00 · walk to Oxford Circus, Central line to Bank, change/walk towards Tower Hill; allow 50 min.

events.title: Dinner around London Bridge
events.detail: Eat before cocktails. Choose a restaurant around London Bridge / Bermondsey Street and reserve once the bar time is secured. Do not rely on Borough Market stalls being open for dinner.
events.travel: 17:45–18:10 · riverside walk towards London Bridge, 25 min.

events.title: GŎNG · cocktails at the Shard
events.detail: Target a 20:00 reservation for four at the level-52 hotel bar. Smart casual; tables are allocated for 90 minutes, and a window seat is not guaranteed. Confirm cancellation terms on the booking. The listed minimum is £30 per adult, but terms can change. This is not a View from the Shard ticket. Nothing is booked.
events.travel: 19:30–20:00 · walk to Shangri-La entrance, security/lift and arrival buffer.

events.title: One more drink · optional
events.detail: Continue nearby if somewhere appeals, or head back. If GŎNG is full, replace the bar slot rather than buying an observation-deck ticket expecting a skybar.
events.travel: London Bridge → Farringdon: allow 30–40 min by Tube with a change; late return by live bus/taxi route.

days.title: Sunday & departures
days.subtitle: Sunday · a short local morning, then separate airport routes

events.title: Brunch & a short Clerkenwell walk
events.detail: An intentionally earlier, optional start. Stay local, check out and collect luggage by noon. If you sleep in, skip the walk—not the airport buffer.

events.title: Collect luggage & check out
events.detail: Confirm the accommodation checkout and luggage arrangements. No afternoon sightseeing.

events.title: Stansted departure route
events.detail: For an assumed 17:00 flight: Farringdon → Liverpool Street by Tube/Elizabeth line, then Stansted Express. Aim to reach the terminal by 14:00–14:15. Allow extra for engineering works and security.
events.travel: Budget up to 2 hr 15 min including walking, interchange, waiting and a roughly 50-minute airport train. Confirm Sunday service before leaving.

events.title: Heathrow departure route
events.detail: For an assumed 17:00 flight: Elizabeth line from Farringdon towards the correct Heathrow terminal. Check the destination: not every westbound train serves Heathrow, and terminal changes take time. Aim to arrive by 14:00–14:15.
events.travel: Budget 1 hr 45 min including station access, waiting and terminal navigation. Airline guidance takes priority.
